title: Theon Group Expands Its Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Footprint through the Slump Sale Acquisition of Maneesh..
thbAction: Position THB's pharma CRM and omnichannel HCP engagement workflows to support launch planning, KAM orchestration, and compliant follow-up across India and the Middle East.
contentHtml:
Theon Group has expanded its pharmaceutical manufacturing footprint through the Slump sale acquisition of Maneesh Pharma Unit VI in Baddi, Himachal Pradesh.The acquired unit will operate under the name Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd. This development marks an important milestone in the Group’s growth journey and reinforces its commitment to expanding manufacturing capabilities and strengthening its presence in the pharmaceutical industry.

With an established presence in pharmaceutical manufacturing, Theon Group continues to pursue strategic growth opportunities that support its long-term business objectives. The addition of Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd. reflects broadening of its operational capabilities and building a more diversified pharmaceutical manufacturing platform.

Advt

Located in Baddi, one of India’s prominent pharmaceutical manufacturing hubs, Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd. will form an important part of Theon Group’s expansion plans. The acquisition is expected to support the Group’s evolving business requirements and create opportunities to serve customers across domestic and international markets.

This development also reflects the Group’s continued commitment to operational excellence, quality-driven manufacturing and long-term customer partnerships. Through strategic investments and the development of its group companies, Theon Group aims to build a strong foundation for sustainable growth.

Zoevita holds WHO-GMP certification, as stated in its current company credentials, and has international regulatory approvals or market authorizations associated with the following countries and authorities like Ethiopia (EFDA), Tanzania (TMDA), Uganda (NDA), Uzbekistan, Myanmar, Yemen.

The company also positions its operations with reference to USFDA and EU compliance expectations.Zoevita operates a modern manufacturing facility designed to support efficient production, consistent product quality, and growing customer requirements. The facility currently manufactures pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products across three key dosage forms: tablets, capsules, and sachets.

Advt

It has an annual manufacturing capacity of 3,000 million tablets per year, 150 million capsules per year and 30 million Sachets per yearWith a continued focus on infrastructure development and business expansion, Zoevita is progressing toward the addition of oral liquid manufacturing sections. These planned developments reflect the company's ambition to broaden its manufacturing capabilities and address a wider range of pharmaceutical & nutraceutical market opportunities in India and overseas.

About Theon GroupTheon Group is a pharmaceutical business group with diversified capabilities across pharmaceutical manufacturing and generic medicines, supported by its group companies: Theon Pharmaceuticals Ltd., Theon Lifesciences Ltd., and Theogen Pvt. Ltd and now Zoevita Lifesciences Ltd

Advt

Theon Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is a leading finished dosage formulation manufacturing company. We are a PIC/S, WHO-GMP, and ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing facility with capabilities for Tablets, Capsules, Oral Suspensions, Dry Powder Injections, Ointments, Creams, and Sachets.
